conviction_note: Two weak opposing reads: management's own lag warning makes the ~$250M revenue bar (Auvelity roughly +16-17% q/q) a stretch on the reported line (print_vs_bar about -1.5%), while the record NBRx run, the 35% de-rating since mid-September and a name that bought a Q2 revenue miss (+3.8%) lean the reaction slightly up. The findings sum to +0.4, p_up is 52, and abs_move is 9 (below the indicative 12.3% implied move, whose ATM spread is 40% of mid, but well above the 3.8% median because this is the first full quarter of the Alzheimer's-agitation launch and the company said it may add launch metrics). The scaled number is +0.36. It agrees in sign with the findings sum, and both are close to zero.
bar: Q3 2026 total net product revenue consensus $249.3M and EPS -$0.65 (Earnings Whispers preview, 2026-10-26: https://www.earningswhispers.com/article/AXSM/21341); a second aggregator gives $253.2M revenue and EPS -$0.56 to -$0.62 (search snippet, not fetched). The two revenue figures agree within 1.6%. No company guidance; the company gives no numeric revenue guide (Q2 release: https://finviz.com/news/379707/axsome-therapeutics-reports-second-quarter-2026-financial-results-and-provides-business-update). Q2 had printed $218.4M against $221-224.5M consensus.
positioning_check: Short interest 7.48% of float, 3.34 days to cover, down 5.89% m/m (MarketBeat AXSM page, read 2026-10-30: https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/axsome-therapeutics-nasdaqaxsm-stock-price-down-4-after-analyst-downgrade-2026-08-03/). FINRA 2026-09-30 settlement: about 3.3M shares, 4.4 DTC, per a curvedtrading snippet (page 403). The short is not crowded. Baseline: 25-delta skew +3.57 vol points (downside paid, moderate); put/call OI 0.48; run-up -19.7% over 20 days and -0.8% over 5; 43.6% below the 52-week high ($260.19 on 2026-06-18) and 8% above the 52-week low; seven straight down weeks since the week ending 2026-09-18 (chartrow). Q2 13F rotation: T. Rowe -51%, Adage -65%, Wellington -43%, BlackRock -21%, against Millennium +535k and Jane Street +400k (quiverquant, 2026-10-23).

findings.finding: At Morgan Stanley's healthcare conference (coverage dated 2026-09-19), management said Auvelity hit a record 3,800 weekly new-to-brand prescriptions (NBRx), against averages of about 2,400 in Q1 and 3,000 in Q2, with three consecutive record weeks. Patients 65+ rose from about 19% of NBRx before the Alzheimer's-agitation approval to about 31%, and agitation is the fastest-growing NBRx segment. Management also said the Q3 report would give a fuller view of the launch and may add launch metrics. The forward volume read for Q4 and 2027 is therefore better than the -35% since mid-September implies.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 (2026-08-10): NBRx +26% q/q, with revenue missing consensus, and the stock rose +3.83%. The 2026-05-04 approval-quarter print rose +8.31%. Six of the last eight prints were up, so this name has paid for forward-volume signals.
findings.why_not_priced: The figures are public, but the stock has fallen about 35% since that week (chartrow weekly returns) with no company-specific negative, and price targets were trimmed while ratings were kept. Had the market priced an accelerating NBRx run, the stock would not be 8% off its 52-week low with the downside paid in the skew. The open question is whether Q3 TRx and the new launch metrics confirm conversion rather than sampling (Earnings Whispers frames the print exactly that way).
findings.independence: The Q2 release (NBRx +26% q/q, 65+ NBRx +126% in the first 8 weeks): https://finviz.com/news/379707/axsome-therapeutics-reports-second-quarter-2026-financial-results-and-provides-business-update. This shares the conference document with finding 2, which reads the same talk's lag caveat the other way.

findings.finding: The revenue bar is demanding against management's own lag statement. At ~$250M total, with Sunosi ~$36-37M and Symbravo ~$3-4M, consensus implies Auvelity of about $209-213M, i.e. +16-18% q/q from $180.3M. At Q2's ~$678 net revenue per TRx (180.3M / 266k), that needs about 310k TRx, or +16% q/q, against +12% q/q in Q2 when NBRx grew 26%. At the September conference management said TRx effects of the NBRx surge would emerge 'over one to two quarters rather than an immediate jump'.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: A Q2 revenue miss ($218.4M against $221-224.5M) still rose +3.83%. A Q4 2025 print with a wider loss fell -4.88% (2026-02-23; itiger 'plummets 5.41%'). This name punishes revenue misses only mildly.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus at $249-253M has not visibly come down to match the stock, which has de-rated 35%. If the sell side had absorbed the 1-2 quarter lag, the published revenue estimate would sit nearer $240M (+10% q/q), the Q2 TRx pace, not at +14-16%. The stock's fall suggests the buy-side whisper is already lower, which is why this is sized small.
findings.independence: The lag statement comes from the conference document (https://longbridge.com/en/news/299531694), which finding 1 also uses. The per-TRx arithmetic uses Q2 release numbers. The pricing step is a proxy inference, not a company number, and net price per TRx rose q/q in Q2 (+5%), which could close part of the gap.

findings.finding: Positioning into the print has been washed out. There are seven consecutive weekly declines (about -40% from the September high), long-only holders cut hard in Q2 13Fs (T. Rowe -51%, Wellington -43%, Adage -65%) while multi-strategy and market-maker funds (Millennium, Jane Street) built positions, and short interest is moderate at 7.5% of float and 3.3 days to cover. The sell side kept Buy ratings (median target $271, Needham reiterated Buy on 2026-10-16) while trimming targets.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After de-ratings into prints this name has bought misses (Q2: -2.4% in the week before, then +3.83% on a miss). The baseline's 6-of-8 up record does not separate de-rated setups.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced by definition: the skew still pays for downside (+3.57) and the implied event move is 12.3%. If the market thought sellers were exhausted, the skew would be flat or call-side. Sized small because the drawdown has no identified cause, and an unexplained drawdown is not evidence of over-reaction.
findings.independence: Weekly returns from https://chartrow.com/quote/axsm/weekly-returns, and short interest from https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/axsome-therapeutics-nasdaqaxsm-stock-price-down-4-after-analyst-downgrade-2026-08-03/ (different sources). The 13F and target data come from the same quiverquant page.

findings.finding: EPS consensus (-$0.65 at Earnings Whispers; -$0.56 to -$0.62 elsewhere) looks too low against management's opex guide. The CFO said Q2 SG&A of $208M is a reasonable H2 reference and R&D ($46M) rises only modestly. With revenue at ~$250M and cost of revenue near Q2's ~6%, the operating loss narrows to roughly -$20 to -$25M, or about -$0.45 to -$0.50 per share on ~52.4M shares, a likely EPS beat if revenue is near consensus.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 EPS missed (-$0.99 against -$0.89) and the stock rose +3.8%. Q4 2025's wider-than-expected loss came with a -4.9% move. EPS is a secondary line for a launch-stage CNS company.
findings.why_not_priced: Estimates appear to carry higher Q3 opex, perhaps DTC for the agitation launch, than management's stated reference. If analysts had used the guide, EPS consensus would sit near -$0.45, not -$0.65. This is small because the stock trades on Auvelity revenue and scripts, not EPS.
findings.independence: The Q2 opex base comes from the Q2 release: https://finviz.com/news/379707/axsome-therapeutics-reports-second-quarter-2026-financial-results-and-provides-business-update. This shares the conference document with findings 1 and 2. If revenue misses (finding 2), this beat shrinks, so the two are partly dependent.

findings.finding: Insiders made 16 open-market sales and no purchases in six months, including the CEO's 149k shares (~$34.4M) and the CFO's 33k (~$7.9M). The August CEO sales were at ~$212 under a 10b5-1 plan, and no October Form 4 was found.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None measurable. These are plan sales through a period in which the stock both rose and fell.
findings.why_not_priced: It is public and largely priced. It is filed only because insiders made no opportunistic purchases at prices 40% lower, which would have been a visible counter-signal had management seen Q3 tracking well ahead.

findings.finding: Topline results from the solriamfetol ENGAGE Phase 3 in binge eating disorder are guided for Q4 2026 (Q2 release). They could be disclosed with or around the Q3 release and would be a binary pipeline readout; the registry earlier showed slippage (AppliedXL).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior solriamfetol Phase 3 readout appears in the baseline. Pipeline news has moved this name (Teva settlement +20%, 2025), but BED is a secondary indication.

findings.why_not_priced: Sized at 0 because the sign is unknown and the timing inside the window is unlikely. It widens the abs move if it lands.

rejected_candidates.detail: Not contradicted as such, but the same 10-Q states receivables are carried gross with reserves netted, and accrued rebates also rose ($299.6M against $232.9M). The gross-up is consistent with gross-to-net accounting on rising volume, so there is no finding.

baseline_tension: Mixed. The reported-quarter finding agrees with the downside-paid skew and the -19.7% run-up, while the NBRx and positioning findings cut against them. Both are small and the net is near zero, so p_up stays at 52.
lessons_applied: Lesson 5 (an unexplained drawdown is not evidence) and lesson 7 (a sign against the downside-paid skew): positioning cut from +1.0 to +0.4.
Lesson 1 (a verified fact is not a reaction; the NBRx figures are public and the stock fell 35% after them): NBRx cut from +1.0 to +0.7.
Lesson 9 (size net of the rest of the company: Sunosi +8% q/q and Symbravo cover part of the gap) and lesson 5 (proxy inference): bar arithmetic cut from -1.0 to -0.8.
Lesson 5 (inference; EPS is not the line this stock trades on): EPS finding cut from +0.5 to +0.3.
Lesson 6: the bar has two estimate sources agreeing within 1.6%, so findings are not capped. Lesson 3: p_up moved from 53 to 52 because the set nets close to zero.
